requirements.title: Required courses
requirements.summary: Complete all eight listed courses. Cross-listed codes identify the same course, not additional requirements.

requirements.title: Eligibility, overlap and preparation
requirements.summary: Any Denison student may pursue the minor. Cognates can overlap with computer science, data analytics and mathematics majors. MATH 145 requires MATH 135 (and potentially preparatory MATH 130), unless placement permits direct entry. CS 145 requires CS 105 or placement. No additional elective choice is listed: all eight named courses are required.

requirements.title: Minor residence requirement
requirements.summary: At least half of the credits applied to the minor must be completed in residence at Denison. The cited graduation policy defines residence through courses scheduled by the registrar, taught on campus by Denison faculty.

requirements.title: Grading and repeated courses
requirements.summary: Students cannot elect S/Grade evaluation for minor courses or required cognates; courses universally offered with satisfactory grading are treated separately. Repeated courses count once for credit, while both grades affect GPA. Repeating a previously passed course requires departmental chair and instructor permission. F and U grades earn no credit.

requirements.title: Minor GPA calculation
requirements.summary: The minor GPA normally includes every course eligible for the minor, including extra courses beyond its minimum. The cited graduation paragraph explicitly gives a 2.0 threshold for the major; it does not separately specify a minor threshold, so none is inferred.

requirements.title: External credit and exceptions
requirements.summary: The program director or department chair determines transfer credit and course equivalence for the minor. Transfer coursework must meet institutional standards, including accreditation, disciplinary fit and at least a C grade; awarded credit cannot exceed the originating credit. Post-matriculation coursework requires advance approval. Off-campus minor credit likewise requires advance program approval. AP, IB and A-level application to a minor is subject to departmental review. The Academic Standing Board considers policy-exception petitions submitted early enough to address a denial. Consult the cited transfer rules for institution-wide credit caps and documentation.

notes: All eight required courses, cross-list equivalences, placement/cognate conditions, eligibility, overlap, residence, grading and external-credit rules are mapped for the minor. Host bachelor degree-wide requirements are outside this credential scope.
Semester credit-hour normalization is supported by the 2026–2027 Academic Credit Policy, which defines course credits over the regular semester.
Course codes preserve cross-listings. Course categories are editorial classifications.
First-offered date is unknown. No launch date inferred from the approval announcement.

The official department requirements page uses the full title Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence; the catalog heading abbreviates it as Machine Learning & AI (ML) and spells it out in the mission statement.

2026-10-11 review retains the exact ML 240/310/400 prerequisite conjunctions with an explicit grouping caveat; their Boolean grouping remains unresolved. These are not converted into inferred enrollment rules. The minor independently requires all eight courses, including the listed cognates, so this metadata ambiguity does not change its local required-course inventory. Mission and communication statements are program aims, while the careers paragraph is a career pathway; no formal assessed learning outcomes are inferred. December 2025 faculty approval does not establish first offering, and the announcement’s early seven-course description does not replace the current eight-course catalog.
